notes: Writers in lineage: 2. Mapped: 1 (Get All Funds\Update agent appointment date, Unsupported direct SQL on Gen_fundmainBase, 3 attributes). Excluded as ETL plumbing: End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish (gen_etlprocess update) and the Script Task 'Create ETL Process record'; 'Get Organization Variables' flow only fills package variables.
The UPDATE goes straight to Gen_fundmainBase (bypasses CRM platform: no plugins/workflows/audit, VersionNumber handled by SQL only). It also sets ModifiedBy/ModifiedOn explicitly.

Candidate funds and the copied date are matched by Gen_customeraccountname, which is the guid lookup from the fund to its customer account (Gen_customeraccountname is the guid lookup to the customer account (dataType guid in 0005_Customer Account.dtsx:2644; joined as fm.Gen_customeraccountname = ca.Gen_customeraccountId in 0015_TransferIn.dtsx:75552)): the date is copied from the most recent dated fund of the same customer account.
Source reads gen_agentappointmentdate as a column, but by its WHERE it is always NULL and it is not mapped into the UPDATE (only a ReadOnly input of 'Create System Variables', unused in code).

The source query uses 'select distinct' over (gen_agentappointmentdate, Gen_fundmainId, AgentAppointmentDateToInsert); Gen_fundmainId is unique per row of Gen_fundmain so each fund is updated once per run.
